question: WISHLIST
answer:
Implemented customer wishlists, wishlist-to-cart moves, product deletion cleanup, and the protected popular-wishlist admin report with validation, limits, sorting, and status handling.

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .team
apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: .team/part-1.md
+Part 1 owns the wishlist domain and persistence layer. Read TASK.md first. Add the customer-scoped wishlist model/entity/repository/service and DTO support needed by the APIs, including add (max 50/idempotent), list newest-first, remove, move coordination helpers, availability/stock checks, and popular aggregation (per store, count distinct customers, top 10 sorted count desc then SKU). Ensure product deletion removes wishlist rows without breaking existing deletion. Own files under sm-core-model/src/main/java and sm-core/src/main/java (and their persistence mappings/config) that implement this domain; do not edit sm-shop API/controller files owned by parts 2/3. Expose clear methods (e.g. WishlistService, add/remove/find/popular and customer lookup) for API parts to call. Run focused module tests/builds.
*** Add File: .team/part-2.md
+Part 2 owns the logged-in customer wishlist HTTP API and presentation models. Read TASK.md first. Implement POST/GET/DELETE /api/v1/auth/customer/wishlist and POST /api/v1/auth/customer/wishlist/{sku}/cart/{cartCode}, using the existing principal/auth patterns and returning exact statuses/payloads/errors. Add request/response DTOs/mappers under sm-shop, and coordinate cart insertion through existing ShoppingCartFacade/ShoppingCartService; only remove wishlist after successful availability/stock/cart update. Depend on Part 1's WishlistService methods and on existing product/cart services. Own only sm-shop customer wishlist API/controller/facade/model/mapper files (plus narrowly necessary Spring wiring), not core domain or admin popular API files.
*** Add File: .team/part-3.md
+Part 3 owns the protected admin popular-wishlist endpoint. Read TASK.md first. Implement GET /api/v1/private/wishlists/popular with store query/admin protection matching existing private APIs, returning up to 10 {sku,count} sorted by count desc then SKU asc. Add only admin API DTO/controller/facade/mapper files under sm-shop, relying on Part 1's WishlistService popular aggregation. Do not edit customer wishlist API or core domain files. Run focused tests/builds.
*** End Patch
PATCH"
